notes.title: Ethereal Enigma - Performance Update for macOS
notes.content:
Hello,

Those on macOS will notice an update today, this is for some performance tuning we did under the hood that should make the game run smoother.

Cheers!

notes.title: Ethereal Enigma Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323887/c363937bc2afbbd98bef223098fa41697228880d.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Ethereal Enigma is available now!

For existing players, your game will automatically update with episode 5 content as well as all the club events. We've also upgraded all the Live2D and character portrait to 4K artwork and made significant performance enhancements on the back-end for a smoother experience. The final chapter is finally here!

For new players, we hope you enjoy the full Ethereal Enigma experience from start to finish!!

As always, please feel free to share your Ethereal Enigma feedback on the [url=discord.gg/pf]PixelFade Discord[/url] server or the Steam discussion boards. ːsteamhappyː

Thanks and happy reading!!
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Episode 4 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323887/933a6e0a2e45e82b10f4ea3eb25d60b4db110d12.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Ethereal Enigma - Episode 4 is available now! Your game will automatically update and you can continue your journey right where you left off.

Although we have resolved all the reported bugs during beta testing, you may run into the occasional issue here or there as development continues; thank you for your understanding. :^)

As always, please feel free to share your Ethereal Enigma feedback on the [url=discord.gg/pf]PixelFade Discord[/url] server or the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1069760/discussions/]discussion boards[/url]. ːsteamhappyː

Thanks and happy reading!!
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Episode 2 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323887/a00b9c974d0469f32741ff836e3ac3913d1a1a46.png[/img]

Hello!

Ethereal Enigma - Episode 2 is available now! Your game should automatically update and you can continue your journey right from where you left off.

Although we have resolved all the reported bugs during beta testing, you may run into the occasional one here and there as we continue to develop the project. You may also run into an inconsistent/missing voice over line but please rest assured it'll be updated within a week or so of the release date!

As always, please let us know your thoughts on Ethereal Enigma on the discussion boards. ːsteamhappyː

Thanks and happy reading!!
- PixelFade Team
